svg.title: AEB vehicle — component layout on a 4-wheel chassis (top view)
svg.text: AEB Vehicle — Component Layout on 4-Wheel Chassis
Top view · Team PRIORITY ZERO · Raspberry Pi 5 + QNX RTOS
front edge · sensor face pointing forward
UART0 → radar · I²C1 → IMU · 12 GPIO → drivers
GPIO24 → interlock sense · GND pin 6 → star point
USB-C power inlet on left edge — keep clear
